name: MGNREGA
full_name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act
benefit: Guaranteed 100 days of employment per year, daily wage ₹250-300
benefit_hindi: हर साल 100 दिन का काम गारंटी, ₹250-300 रोज़ की मज़दूरी

eligibility.description: Any adult member of a rural household willing to do unskilled manual work
eligibility.description_hindi: Gaon ka koi bhi vyakti jo haath se kaam karna chahta hai
criteria: Must be adult member of rural household
Willing to do unskilled manual work
Must apply for Job Card at Gram Panchayat

steps: Apply for Job Card with photo and address proof
Apply for work — must be given within 15 days
If work not given in 15 days, unemployment allowance applicable
steps_hindi: Photo aur address proof ke saath Job Card ke liye apply karein
15 din mein Job Card mil jayega
Kaam ke liye apply karein — 15 din mein kaam milna chahiye
Agar 15 din mein kaam nahi mila toh berozgaari bhatta milega

hindi_summary: MGNREGA mein gaon ke har parivaar ko saal mein 100 din kaam ki guarantee hai. Rozana 250 se 300 rupaye milte hain. Gram Panchayat se Job Card banwaayein aur kaam ke liye apply karein.
